position: Ranking should reward direct evidence and penalize rights gaps, review gaps, and risky overclaiming.
headline: Rank by trust, not by confidence alone.
copy: A candidate may match the words in a question and still be unsafe for an answer if rights, review, or boundary signals are weak.

postures.title: Direct reviewed source
postures.copy: Reviewed source id, citation, and answer boundary are all present.

postures.title: Useful but incomplete
postures.copy: Candidate exists, but rights, translation, or reviewer fields are incomplete.

postures.title: No reliable source
postures.copy: No reviewed source supports the claim or the claim asks for overreach.

flow.title: Fit
flow.copy: Question terms match the source record.

flow.title: Citation
flow.copy: Citation and source id are stable.

decisions.label: Fit score
decisions.reason: Strong semantic or curated alias match.

decisions.label: Citation quality
decisions.reason: Stable source id, family, and citation.

decisions.label: Rights hold
decisions.reason: Missing edition or display permission blocks answer rendering.

decisions.label: Review hold
decisions.reason: Mantra, commentary, or claim-check records need human review.

decisions.label: Overclaim risk
decisions.reason: Modern proof, miracle, medical, ritual, or authority claims must not rank into answers.

decisions.label: No-source floor
decisions.reason: Below threshold, create a ticket instead of answering.

packet:
Ranking contract v4.4.2
Return: source_id, citation, family, fit_score, citation_score, rights_penalty, review_penalty, boundary_penalty, final_score, decision.
Never rank a blocked source into answer-ready output.

locks.title: Review before confidence
locks.copy: A useful source can still need human review.

locks.title: Refusal before overclaim
locks.copy: Low or risky matches should become no-source packets.
